_comment_spend: Spend efficiency (BRO spend review 2026-10-01, plan-review pass recorded). env: compact at 320k instead of running to 600-780k in the 1M variants (owner-approved 2026-10-03: the earlier 200k cap with 1M disabled left only ~80k of work room above ~85k of fixed setup, so autocompact thrashed); 71% of Sep cloud cost came from sessions past 400k, re-read on every step. effortLevel: Opus 5.5 default is medium; /effort or --effort still raises it per session (do NOT use CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, it would override /effort). This file is read by cloud sessions, Mac interactive sessions and Mac headless jobs (they run in repo worktrees; strippedEnv in scripts/lib/claude-cli.js never forwards shell vars), so it is the single source for these knobs. Revert = delete these two keys. Keep the window well above 2x the fixed setup cost or autocompact thrashes.

_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code config. Loaded by cloud apps (iOS, Mac, web) that can't reach the user's ~/.claude/. Each project hook script begins with a self-skip preamble: if ~/.claude/hooks/<basename> exists (local CLI), the project copy exits 0 and the user-level master fires. On cloud sandboxes ~/.claude/hooks/ does not exist, so the project copy runs. See .claude/CLOUD.md.
_comment_permissions: Server-level MCP allow: 'mcp__<server>' pre-approves the Claude_Code_Remote tools that are NOT marked requiresUserInteraction (get_session, list_triggers, delete_trigger, ...). Cloud sessions name the server 'Claude_Code_Remote' (tools are mcp__Claude_Code_Remote__*), so the old 'claude-code-remote' entry never matched and add_repo/send_later kept hitting the approval wall (BRO-4216); both spellings are listed. Harmless on local CLI where the server isn't connected. KNOWN LIMIT (BRO-4236): add_repo, send_later and create_trigger are marked requiresUserInteraction, which per code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes ('Actions no mode auto-approves') prompts even when an allow rule matches, in every mode. No allow rule or mode fixes that; don't re-add rules for them. Instead the PreToolUse hook block-prompting-remote-tools.sh denies the calls that have a prompt-free equivalent before the prompt appears. list_sessions and create_session prompt in practice too, Auto mode included (owner screenshots 2026-10-04, BRO-4635): the hook denies list_sessions (get_session by id is the prompt-free route); create_session is allowed (BRO-5040: the owner wants sessions started and accepts one tap each); the hook denies a source_url that misspells Broadwayscore, which would start the session outside the project (BRO-5068), and a create_session without an explicit full model id, on Fable, or on Opus with no MODEL-REASON: line in the prompt (BRO-5228), and on Opus when the card policy plus daily Opus budget says Sonnet, with no OWNER-ASKED-OPUS: line, or with BUDGET over 4h (BRO-6684, scripts/opus-launch-check-hook.js). list_events is unverified. LINEAR (BRO-7526): 'mcp__Linear' lets every tool of a server named Linear run without a prompt (owner set the connector to always-allow; Auto mode and the connector toggle did not stop the Save Comment / Save Issue prompts in cloud). It does not match the cloud containers where the connector is named mcp__<uuid>__* (scripts/lib/root-cause-stop.mjs) or the Mac name mcp__claude_ai_Linear__*. If prompts persist in a session, read the tool prefix in the prompt and add that server name here; a PreToolUse allow hook is the fallback. PEER MESSAGING (BRO-7885, owner 2026-11-21 option A): 'SendMessage' and 'ListAgents' (local peer tools) had no allow rule, so a desktop tab that could not render the prompt ended in a silent 'needs approval' refusal; they and send_message are now allowed by exact name (the server-wide mcp__ entries already covered send_message in cloud; the exact names matter for the local tools). Scope: this list reaches single-repo sessions on the Mac and multi-repo cloud sessions via the installer; a Mac session opened in another repo or in ~ needs the same entries in the owner's own ~/.claude/settings.json, which cloud cannot edit. Not fixable by any rule: the RECEIVING session holds a cross-session message for its own user when it runs in a different permission mode, and cloud -> Mac needs a one-time owner tap on confirm_repository_trust in the Claude app. A session whose send was refused or went unanswered must say 'could not reach session X' in its final message, never end KEEP OPEN waiting. Multi-repo sessions read this list only through scripts/install-home-claude-config.js.
